# TrackPinch v0.1.0-alpha.3

This experimental preview gives TrackPinch a clear first-run experience while
keeping the app menu-bar-only during everyday use.

## Improvements

- Open a dedicated setup window on the first launch instead of relying on a
  transient menu bar popover
- Explain that TrackPinch lives in the menu bar and does not keep a Dock icon
- Guide users through Accessibility and the horizontal, vertical, and diagonal
  resize gesture in two focused steps
- Keep setup visible while macOS System Settings is open
- Hand off to the menu bar popover when setup finishes
- Add a persistent `Setup Guide` action so onboarding can be reopened at any time
- Keep the universal app compatible with Apple Silicon and Intel Macs

Fresh installs show the setup window automatically. Existing alpha users can
open it from `Setup Guide` in the menu bar popover.

## Verification

- 33 Swift tests pass
- Strict Swift concurrency build passes with warnings treated as errors
- Release packaging includes both `arm64` and `x86_64`

## Important trust notice

This alpha DMG is **ad hoc signed and not notarized** because a Developer ID
certificate is not yet available. Gatekeeper is expected to block the first
launch. Do not disable Gatekeeper globally. Testers who accept this limitation
can use the per-app **Open Anyway** control in **System Settings → Privacy &
Security** after attempting the first launch.

The finished release will use Developer ID signing, Hardened Runtime, secure
timestamping, notarization, and stapling.

## Permissions and privacy

TrackPinch requires Accessibility permission to resize the active window and
to recognize and suppress its configured gesture. It runs locally with no
account, analytics, ads, update service, or network communication. Typed key
contents are not recorded.

## Known limitations

- Signed-build QA across the complete supported OS/device/app matrix is incomplete.
- Launch at login and automatic updates are not implemented.
- Fullscreen, tiled, sheet, and panel windows are not guaranteed to resize.
